===Levels 1–10/34: Questing===
Early levels can be skipped by completing [[Quest experience rewards#Magic|quests that give Magic experience]]. Completing [[Witch's Potion]] and [[Imp Catcher]] gives a total of 1,200 Magic experience, which is enough to get from level 1 to 10. Both quests are very short and have no requirements, and they can be done at any level.

To get to level 34 only by questing, completing [[Fairytale I - Growing Pains]] or [[The Grand Tree]] allows [[Watchtower]] to be completed. Completing all three and [[Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide|Lumbridge Guide subquest of Recipe for Disaster]] would grant an additional 20,900 experience and get the player up to level 34.
